mapper.insert: insert into user_message (user_id, send_user_id, msg_type, book_id, book_index_id, target_id, content, read_flag, create_time) values (#{userId}, #{sendUserId}, #{msgType}, #{bookId}, #{bookIndexId}, #{targetId}, #{content}, 0, now())
mapper.select: select t1.id, t1.user_id, t1.send_user_id, t1.msg_type, t1.book_id, t1.book_index_id, t1.target_id, t1.content, t1.read_flag, t1.create_time, t2.username send_user_name, t2.user_photo send_user_photo, t3.book_name, t4.index_name from user_message t1 inner join user t2 on t1.send_user_id = t2.id left join book t3 on t1.book_id = t3.id left join book_index t4 on t1.book_index_id = t4.id where t1.user_id = #{userId} and t1.msg_type = #{msgType} order by t1.read_flag, t1.create_time desc
